review_candidates.description: Mission Delivery Engineer Department: Missions Line of Business Location: ICEYE Espoo / Warsaw Reports to: Mission Program Director Employment type: Permanent Working type: Hybrid (3 days / week in office) Employment is subject to applicable security screening Why This Role Matters As a Mission Delivery Engineer you will support the delivery of complex Satellite Mission programs end-to-end with deep technical ownership, ensuring customer success, on-time execution, and scalable delivery excellence. You will work across the Portfolio focusing on the technical thread of customer missions—from requirements capture through system acceptance and delivery—acting as the technical authority/interface between the customer and ICEYE's engineering, product, and operations teams. Your role bridges program governance and system engineering: ensuring mission requirements are understood, flowed down, tracked, and validated, while maintaining configuration control and driving cross-functional technical alignment throughout the program lifecycle. This role directly contributes to ICEYE's ambition to become the leading provider of space-based ISR infrastructure by scaling reliable, high-impact mission delivery globally. The role will be based in Finland or Poland at the ICEYE facility. Travel to customer sites is required. Who We Are ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth. ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. Expected Outcomes & Requirements Outcomes Customer technical requirements are accurately captured, baselined, and flowed down to engineering teams, ensuring all mission commitments are fully traceable from contract to delivery. Customers experience a consistent, high-trust technical partnership, with a single accountable interface that understands their systems and operational needs throughout the program lifecycle. System integration, verification, and validation activities are planned and executed rigorously, ensuring all delivered capabilities are compliant with mission and contractual requirements. Configuration and interface control is maintained across all mission segments—satellite, ground, networks, and user interfaces—minimising risk from upgrades, changes, and inter-system dependencies. Technical risks, discrepancies, and gaps are identified early, escalated effectively and resolved proactively through structured coordination across software, hardware, operations, and QA teams. Cross-functional technical teams operate in alignment, with clear ownership and system-level perspective maintained across all reviews, delivery milestones, and readiness checks. Technical documentation—including CONOPS, ICDs, verification matrices, mission analysis, and acceptance reports—is delivered on time and kept current with the actual system implementation. Role-Specific Competencies 5+ years' experience delivering complex, multi-stakeholder technical programs in advanced technology environments (e.g. space, defence, telecom, automotive, IT) Proven ability to own the technical customer interface, managing senior stakeholders and translating operational requirements into engineering deliverables Hands-on experience with requirements management, traceability, and configuration control across hardware, software, and system-level domains Demonstrated involvement in system integration, verification and validation (V&V) planning and execution, including acceptance testing campaigns Strong cross-functional technical coordination skills across engineering, product, and operations disciplines Experience of carrying out analysis and mission design using software packages such as STK, SaVoir, MONTE or GMAT Excellent communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences, including formal reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, DRR) Degree in engineering, systems engineering, computer science, or a related technical field Must have or be able to obtain required security clearances Nice-to-have Experience in Earth Observation (EO), SAR, or remote sensing Background in space mission systems or satellite ground segment development Experience working with government or defence customers on classified or sovereign programs Knowledge of hardware/software integration, API control, and embedded systems Familiarity with ESA or equivalent program documentation frameworks Advanced degree (Master's) or relevant certifications (e.g. PMP, PgMP, INCOSE CSEP) Application Process Initial screening call with Talent Attraction Hiring Manager interview with Mission Program Director Case Study & Interview Sales Engineering Director Final interview with SVP Missions References Working at ICEYE At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win. How We Work (Our Values) Make the impossible possible : We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way. Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions. See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others. Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions. Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift. Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins. Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table. We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help. Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

Implantar e integrar sistemas tecnológicos aeroportuarios en entornos operativos complejos. Gestionar la operación y el mantenimiento de sistemas críticos, garantizando su disponibilidad y rendimiento. Analizar, diagnosticar y resolver incidencias técnicas, asegurando la continuidad del servicio. Coordinar actividades con proveedores, operadores aeroportuarios y otros equipos involucrados en el proyecto. Participar en proyectos de diseño, despliegue y evolución de sistemas aeroportuarios. Elaborar documentación técnica y realizar seguimiento de las actuaciones realizadas. 🎯 ¿Qué buscamos en ti? Experiencia de entre 3 y 10 años en sistemas aeroportuarios. Participación en proyectos de diseño, implantación o mantenimiento de sistemas en aeropuertos. Experiencia en uno o varios de los siguientes sistemas: A-CDM (Airport Collaborative Decision Making), FIDS (Flight Information Display System), AODB (Airport Operational Database) o RMS (Resource Management System). Titulación en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Industrial o similar. Capacidad de coordinación con múltiples proveedores. Disponibilidad para desplazamientos puntuales. Nivel de inglés B2 o superior 🚀 ¿Qué te ofrecemos? Proyectos innovadores y de alto alcance: Trabajarás con tecnologías de vanguardia, con un impacto tanto a nivel nacional como internacional. Plan de carrera adaptado a ti: Diseñado para impulsar tu crecimiento y desarrollo profesional. Autonomía y Flexibilidad : Tendrás libertad para organizar tu trabajo, con una conciliación real y adaptada a tu ritmo. Estabilidad y futuro: Proyectos a largo plazo en una empresa líder con más de 60.000 profesionales , con seguridad financiera. Días de vacaciones + días de libre disposición . Ambiente cercano y transparente: Disfrutarás de una comunicación directa y fluida con responsables y compañeros, en un entorno colaborativo y abierto. Formación continua: en Open University y Udemy for Business (¡más de 6.000 cursos para especializarte!) Descuentos y ventajas para empleados: Disfruta de ventajas en gimnasios, restaurantes, tiendas, ocio y mucho más al ser empleado de Indra. Servicio de autobuses con diferentes rutas dirigidas a centros de trabajo fuera de la ciudad de Madrid. 🕓 ¿Cómo es nuestro proceso de selección? Revisión de tu perfil: Evaluamos tu experiencia y habilidades para determinar si encajas con lo que buscamos. Primera toma de contacto (5-10 min): Si recibes una llamada de un número desconocido, ¡es nuestro equipo! Será una conversación rápida para conocerte y resolver cualquier duda. Entrevista técnica: Te reunirás con el equipo, quienes te explicarán el proyecto y las tareas diarias. También exploraremos tus conocimientos técnicos. Además, te realizaremos breves pruebas de competencias psicológicas e inglés (si es necesario). Oferta y bienvenida: Si todo va bien, ¡te incorporas a nuestro equipo y comenzamos esta nueva etapa juntos! Tiempo Estimado de proceso: 2 -3 semanas. Desde esta convicción, reafirmamos nuestro compromiso con la igualdad de trato y de oportunidades entre mujeres y hombres, la no discriminación, la igualdad retributiva y la conciliación de la vida profesional y personal. review_candidates.title: Human Resource Business Partner, Côte d'Ivoire
review_candidates.description: About Zipline Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. About You And The Role Zipline has launched its life-saving delivery services in Côte d’Ivoire and is continuing to grow everyday. To ensure the rapidly-growing team is set for success, we are hiring a Human Resources Business Partner who has a deep knowledge of how to build highly motivated and engaged teams, ensure our company is run at the highest standards of HR compliance, and partner with leadership to drive high performance culture, team engagement, and leadership support. You will be trusted with the responsibility of driving a high performance culture within our operations team and the business. Additionally, you will help create people tools and programs that will allow the people team to continue providing the highest level of support to our teams as we scale. What You'll Do Become an expert on the business and the unique challenges Zipline faces as we scale in Côte d’Ivoire Partner closely with operational leads, providing guidance and holding them accountable for high performing teams that do amazing work, on time. Act as a culture ambassador, emulating Zipline’s values and helping leads to incorporate them into their conversations around engagement, coaching & development and performance management. Work closely with leads on effective headcount planning and organizational design. Coach Leads regarding the importance of effective on-boarding for new hires/internal transfers and holding leads accountable to developing these plans. Hold leads (managers) accountable for giving clear and actionable performance feedback to everyone on their team through micro and macro feedback. Give direct feedback to leaders when they aren’t meeting Zipline’s leadership expectations. Drive company-wide performance calibrations and compensation reviews, ensuring a fair and equitable process. Design intentional and scalable Human Resource processes that work for our unique business. Help to keep Zipline compliant with labor laws and regulations. Assess team member concerns and complaints and work closely with legal counsel to conduct thorough, unbiased investigations and recommended outcomes. What You'll Bring 8+ years of experience in a People or Human Resource role. Fluency in written & spoken English and French. Ability to build strong relationships and earn trust with team members all throughout the organization. Solid intuition on how to drive organization change in order to improve performance. Ability to spot and help solve humans working with human problems. Physically accessible and approachable, there is no better way to keep your finger on the pulse of your business than by keeping yourself actively involved in your team and the company’s day-to-day affairs. Demonstrated ability to deliver hard messages to leaders directly. Ability to cut through complex issues and find simple solutions. High level of discretion with sensitive people's information and can act impartially and objectively. Must be eligible to work in Côte d’Ivoire. What Else You Need To Know Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, military or veteran status, citizenship, or other characteristics protected by state, federal or local law or our other policies. We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply! Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file.
